findings.before: /export rendered a Seed Data tab and could invoke seed-database.
findings.root_cause: Production route exposed development seed capability.
findings.change: Removed seed import, state, handler, tab, summary, and result UI from DatabaseExport; retained legitimate export/import.
findings.after: DatabaseExport has no seed references and production bundle contains no seed path/UI strings.
findings.residual_risk: Isolated useSeedDatabase hook remains in source for controlled tooling; no production page imports it.

findings.before: Panitia saw assignment CTA while route required requireAdmin.
findings.root_cause: CTA and route capability policy drift.
findings.change: Changed canAssignReferees to require isAdmin() and approved event status.
findings.after: Non-admin event roles do not receive the CTA; route remains admin-protected.
findings.residual_risk: Browser direct-role verification remains to be performed.

findings.before: MobileNav linked /database-export, which was not registered.
findings.after: Mobile export item targets registered protected route.

findings.before: admin_kab_kota saw /approvals despite route requiring admin_provinsi.
findings.change: Removed approval item from non-admin-provinsi branch; retained it for admin_provinsi.
findings.after: Unauthorized role no longer receives guaranteed-forbidden menu item.
findings.residual_risk: Direct URL guard remains to be exercised in browser/non-production.

findings.before: Assignment event/assignment/suggestion failures could appear as empty/not-found/no recommendation.
findings.change: Added event error/retry and assignment query error/retry panels in RefereeAssignment and EventDetail.
findings.after: Code distinguishes key query failures and exposes retry controls.
findings.residual_risk: No simulated query-failure browser test or network/offline test.

findings.before: Admin mutation accepted all status values and directly updated status without transition-specific contract.
findings.change: Restricted admin step-up mutation and UI to pending -> confirmed; added pending-row predicate; terminal/cancellation paths are no longer offered by this mutation.
findings.after: Direct admin mutation cannot submit non-confirmation status and cannot update a non-pending row.
findings.residual_risk: Authorized Non-Production mutation, audit, notification, and RLS validation not executed; cancellation remains separate canonical flow.

findings.before: Role/remove/confirmation controls lacked complete pending disablement.
findings.change: Disabled role select, remove, and confirmation controls during relevant mutations; guarded role change while pending.
findings.after: Affected controls prevent duplicate clicks while mutation is pending.
validation: assignment contract test asserts all three disabled controls

findings.before: Referee query failure rendered ordinary empty states.
findings.change: Added combined upcoming/past/pending error state and retry in RefereeEvents.
findings.after: Failed referee-event retrieval is distinct from empty tabs in code.

findings.before: No typecheck script; lint baseline exited 1 with 66 errors and 11 warnings.
findings.change: Added npm run typecheck without changing lint configuration or dependencies.
findings.after: Typecheck is reproducible and passes; lint remains unchanged at 66 errors/11 warnings across 41 baseline files.
validation: npm run lint exit 1, 66 errors/11 warnings
findings.residual_risk: Lint gate still fails and must be dispositioned or remediated before UAT.
